svg.title: Throughput and five-run observed ranges
svg.desc: Each baseline throughput median is normalized to 100%. Dots and whiskers show medians and observed minimum/maximum of five runs for each version. Candidate percentages and median changes are listed separately.

g.text: Each baseline median = 100%; five runs per version; workloads are not aggregated.
Dots: medians. Whiskers: observed min–max of five runs, not confidence intervals.
Per run: 1 s warmup + 5 s measurement. Each row has its own baseline normalization.
